label: Soil
text: EA.O.A4.5 Soil. The soil body: weathered parent material plus organic matter, organised in horizons. Pedology owns the profile here. Soil mechanics (effective stress, Mohr–Coulomb) is EN. Soil chemistry is CH. Soil biota are BI.O.A5.3.
